rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The Hindi original of the INC's release of 16 December 2017 is headed 'नये अध्यक्ष श्री राहुल गांधी के चुनाव प्रमाण–पत्र स्वीकार करने के अवसर पर निवर्तमान कांग्रेस अध्यक्ष श्रीमती सोनिया गांधी का भाषण' (speech of the outgoing Congress President Smt. Sonia Gandhi on the occasion of the new President Shri Rahul Gandhi accepting the election certificate), 24 Akbar Road, New Delhi, 16 December 2017.

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: In the same speech she says 'आज मैं आखिरी बार आपको कांग्रेस अध्यक्ष के रूप में सम्बोधित कर रही हूं' (today I address you for the last time as Congress President) and closes 'आज इस ज़िम्मेदारी को छोड़ते हुए' (today, relinquishing this responsibility) with her thanks; the INC's English translation renders these as 'This is my last address to you as Congress President' and 'in laying down this office'.

locator.item: Hindi opening (page 4) and close (page 8); English translation, first and last paragraphs
